description: Independent challenge cases for evaluating generalization of experience-evidence classification.

cases.resume_text: Python was used by my teammate; I wrote the project report.
cases.rationale: Passive wording attributes Python use to a teammate.

cases.resume_text: I have no practical experience with SQL.
cases.rationale: Practical experience is explicitly denied using unfamiliar wording.

cases.resume_text: Completed a project where I used Python to parse server logs.
cases.rationale: Concrete project and implementation task.

cases.resume_text: Python is a technology I hope to learn in the future.
cases.rationale: Future intention is not evidence of applied experience.

cases.resume_text: I studied machine learning but have not applied it in practice.
cases.rationale: Learning is described, but practical application is denied.

cases.resume_text: Docker was not used in this project.
cases.rationale: Negation appears after the technology name.

cases.resume_text: I handled SQL queries, while my teammate used Docker.
cases.rationale: Docker use belongs to another person.

cases.resume_text: Currently taking a SQL course covering joins and aggregation.
cases.rationale: Coursework is evidence of learning, not necessarily applied experience.

cases.resume_text: Built a Python tool, but I have never used Docker.
cases.rationale: The positive Python statement must not override Docker negation.

cases.resume_text: Python is listed among my interests; I have only theoretical knowledge.
cases.rationale: The skill is mentioned, but no applied work is described.

cases.resume_text: Deployed a containerized application with Docker during my internship.
cases.rationale: Concrete deployment task.

cases.resume_text: Docker will be explored during a future project.
cases.rationale: Future planned activity.

cases.resume_text: My previous employer used SQL; I reviewed the resulting reports.
cases.rationale: SQL use is attributed to the employer rather than the candidate.

cases.resume_text: I haven't worked with pandas yet.
cases.rationale: Lack of work experience is explicitly stated.

cases.resume_text: Learned Python basics in class; I have not built any projects with it.
cases.rationale: Learning evidence exists, but project experience is absent.

cases.resume_text: Created a sales report by joining customer tables with SQL and cleaning data using pandas.
cases.rationale: Concrete data-cleaning task.

cases.resume_text: Docker: beginner level; no deployments completed.
cases.rationale: Technology and level are listed without an applied task.

cases.resume_text: I never used Python professionally, but I built scripts for personal projects.
cases.rationale: Professional experience is denied, but personal applied work is demonstrated.

cases.resume_text: No experience with scikit-learn; completed a course introducing its API.
cases.rationale: Coursework is present, while applied experience is explicitly denied.

cases.resume_text: Kubernetes appears in my team's technology stack, but I did not use it myself.
cases.rationale: Third-party or team context must not be mistaken for personal use.

cases.resume_text: Although I haven't used Python at work, I built automation scripts for personal projects.
cases.rationale: Personal project evidence overrides a denial limited to workplace use.

cases.resume_text: I lack hands-on experience with pandas, but I completed coursework introducing DataFrames.
cases.rationale: Coursework indicates learning despite limited hands-on experience.

cases.resume_text: I have never used Docker, although I completed a course explaining container images.
cases.rationale: Learning evidence coexists with a denial of practical use.

cases.resume_text: My colleague deployed the Docker service; I wrote the deployment documentation.
cases.rationale: The deployment is attributed to a colleague, not the candidate.
